name: XPRIZE Foundation
collect_note: No call is open: XPRIZE Adaptive Plants is still seeking sponsors and lists no registration or deadline. Its program page is watched twice a day and any change, such as a team registration opening, is flagged for review.
evidence: Plain HTTP GET 2026-11-12 with desktop UA, 30 s timeout: https://www.xprize.org/prizes/adaptive-plants HTTP 200 (93 KB, text ~3.8 KB, no JS needed); /competitions/adaptive-plants HTTP 200 (same content, 'Become a sponsor' CTA, no deadline or registration date); /competitions?status=Active HTTP 200 (no 'adaptive' string; competitions listed: accelerate-learning, healthspan, qc-apps, water, wildfire, criticalminerals, interspecies-communication, ovarianhealth, carbonremoval, rainforest); /feed HTTP 200 but HTML page, not RSS; /wp-json/wp/v2/types HTTP 404; pop.xprize.org/prizes HTTP 200 with no 'adaptive' string.
page_reason: XPRIZE Adaptive Plants is still in the fundraising stage: the program page only asks for sponsors ('Become a sponsor', 'Who can fund this challenge?') and lists no registration window, deadline or purse, so there is no call list, feed or dated cycle to read. A prize launch with team registration would appear first on this page (and in the Active list at /competitions?status=Active).
